summary.text: Cassie Easley is the Constitution Party nominee for Utah's 3rd Congressional District and has run for Congress in Utah before. She lives in Enoch, is a student at Southern Utah University and a certified firearms instructor, and says she is running on strict adherence to the Constitution, Second Amendment rights and limiting federal spending to enumerated powers.

paragraphs.text: Cassie Easley describes herself as the daughter of a Navy veteran who grew up as a "Navy brat" and has lived in rural Utah for 20 years; she lives in Enoch, Utah.
According to her Ballotpedia survey, she is a student at Southern Utah University, studying political science, economics, and agriculture and range studies with a minor in legal studies.
She describes herself as a certified firearms and concealed-carry instructor and a member of Gun Owners of America, the National Rifle Association and the United States Concealed Carry Association.

Easley describes herself as a Constitution Party leader and National Committee member. She ran as the party's candidate in the 2023 special election for Utah's 2nd District, receiving 2.3%, and in the 2024 general election for the same seat, receiving 5.6%.
She says she volunteers with the Utah Food Bank and Operation Christmas Child.
